narrativeProgression.description: Kevin welcomes viewers to BCH Technologies.
The video cuts to a printer in recovery mode.
The video cuts to a laptop screen displaying an error message and a link to download the Epson Firmware Updater.
The video cuts to the Epson support website, where Kevin navigates to the firmware download section.
Kevin demonstrates the first method of installing the firmware update.
The printer remains in recovery mode after the first installation attempt.
Kevin introduces the second method for addressing the issue.
Kevin demonstrates the second method, which involves a specific key combination and power cycling.
The printer successfully exits recovery mode and enters normal operation.
The video transitions to a factory setting with conveyor belts carrying boxes branded with the BCH logo.

youtube_description:
If you have an Epson printer, you may find the printer is stuck in Recovery Mode.  This message is displayed on the product’s LCD screen and you will be unable to perform any actions until this issue is resolved.
This error occurs if the firmware update procedure is interrupted, e.g. accidental powering off the product, cables being removed or the installation is canceled.  To recover from this error, Epson would instruct customers to update their printer with the latest version of the firmware.  However, this method does not always work.  Therefore, we offer two solutions here.
youtube_title: 2 WAYS - Solve Epson Printers Stuck in Recovery Mode - Fix Firmware Error
